288:t_2:68.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I see... So you're the one who took care of those guys.」

288:t_2:71.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「As I thought... So you're the $$破嵐万丈$$ I've heard rumors about.」

288:t_2:72.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$沈黙の巨蟹$$, $$尸空#pilot$$... I've heard about you too.」

288:t_2:73.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Yin and yang meet... Is this what they call fate?」

288:t_2:74.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$サイデリアル$$... I've already learned that you are $$クロノ$$'s superiors.」

288:t_2:76.en:
$$万丈$$
「I swear on this red earth. I will never allow you to exist.」

289:t_000:0.en:
$$キャシー$$
「All $c ships have descended into Mars's atmosphere.」

289:t_000:1.en:
$$ボビー$$
「It brings back memories... Not since the decisive battle of the $$再世戦争$$.」

289:t_000:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Here we defeated Prince $$ユーサー$$ of $$インサラウム$$, sealed $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$, and settled things with $$ガイオウ$$, the $$破界の王$$...」

289:t_001:0.en:
$$田中司令$$
「As I feared, $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ has stopped functioning...」

289:t_001:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「If it hadn't, $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$ would never have been revived in the first place.」

289:t_001:2.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「According to $$ランド$$ and $$セツコ$$, once someone who draws out $$次元力$$ is sealed in $$ＺＯＮＥ$$, escaping on their own is impossible.」

289:t_001:3.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Then naturally, that means someone woke that dangerous man from his sleep.」

289:t_001:4.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Who on earth did such a thing, and for what purpose...」

289:t_001:5.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「First, let's hear what they have to say.」

289:t_002:0.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「...We have come to receive you, everyone from $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$.」

289:t_002:1.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Pardon me. It's $c now, isn't it?」

289:t_002:2.en:
$$ボビー$$
「《$$インサラウム$$》's 《$$アークセイバー$$》, I see.」

289:t_002:3.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「These days, we too are members of the $$地球連邦$$.」

289:t_002:4.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「You must be tired from the long journey. We will show you to our living quarters.」

289:t_002:5.en:
$$スメラギ$$
($$ユーサー・インサラウム$$... What you did was not in vain.)

289:t_002:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
(This is how they live with us now. As comrades advancing into the future together.)

289:t_002:7.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
(So sleep easy. $$尽きぬ水瓶$$, Holy King $$インサラウム$$.)

294:t_1:3.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

294:t_1:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「...So you all got warped to Southeast Asia...」

294:t_1:5.en:
$$カレン$$
「Yeah... We fled to $$クメン$$ and ended up being looked after by some old friends.」

294:t_1:6.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「In $$クメン$$, apart from the guerrilla group of $$ポタリア$$ and his people, 《$$マーティアル$$》 are also fighting the $$サイデリアル$$.」

294:t_1:7.en:
$$甲児$$
「So $$シャッコ$$ had joined up too.」

294:t_1:8.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$マーティアル$$... That religion from $$アストラギウス$$ that teaches that battle makes humanity evolve...」

294:t_1:9.en:
$$甲児$$
「So that's how she became one of us too...」

294:t_1:11.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「$$テイタニア・ダ・モンテ＝ウェルズ$$... As you know, a former 《$$ネクスタント$$》 of the $$マーティアル$$.」

294:t_1:13.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$テイタニア$$ left the $$マーティアル$$. That's why they're after her.」

294:t_1:14.en:
$$アルト$$
「So she ran to us for shelter, is that it...」

294:t_1:16.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Stop. It isn't that woman's fault, or anyone's, that $$フィアナ$$ died.」

294:t_1:18.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$キリコ$$ says it's fine. It's not our place to say anything about it.」

294:t_1:21.en:
$$テイタニア$$
($$フィアナ$$ entrusted her feelings to me... I will keep chasing $$キリコ$$...)

294:t_1:22.en:
$$テイタニア$$
(That is what I live for.)

294:t_1:23.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I heard $$宗介$$ was acting separately back then, though...」

294:t_1:24.en:
$$宗介$$
「I was fighting in the arena at $$ナムサク$$ while gathering intel on $$アマルガム$$.」

294:t_1:25.en:
$$バナージ$$
「An arena... You mean that thing where they turn AS and $$ＡＴ$$ fights into a spectacle?」

294:t_1:26.en:
$$クルツ$$
「That's not all. The spectators bet money on who wins.」

294:t_1:27.en:
$$マオ$$
「A whole lot of money changes hands there. It must have been one of $$アマルガム$$'s sources of funds.」

294:t_1:28.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「That white and blue $$サベージ$$, was that the unit you used there?」

294:t_1:29.en:
$$宗介$$
「Its name is $$アル$$ II... no, $$クロスボウ$$.」

294:t_1:30.en:
$$宗介$$
($$ナミ$$... I will never forget the time I spent with you.)

294:t_1:31.en:
$$宗介$$
($$レモン$$ will keep you safe. Forget that you're a $$ウィスパード$$ and survive...)

294:t_1:32.en:
$$シン$$
「But it's a relief... the $$アーバレスト$$ is safe too.」

294:t_1:33.en:
$$宗介$$
「It has neither $$アル$$ nor a $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ installed. It's a hollow shell, so to speak.」

294:t_1:34.en:
$$マオ$$
「...$$ミスリル$$'s main facilities, starting with $$メリダ島$$, were wiped out by an attack from $$アマルガム$$, who had teamed up with the $$サイデリアル$$.」

294:t_1:36.en:
$$クルツ$$
「The $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ barely escaped from $$メリダ島$$, but in that battle old man $$カリーニン$$ went missing.」

294:t_1:38.en:
$$宗介$$
「Don't make that face, $$バナージ$$. There's no way the Major dies that easily.」

294:t_1:39.en:
$$マオ$$
「Besides, $$ミスリル$$ isn't completely dead. The members who are left are each continuing the fight as guerrillas.」

294:t_1:40.en:
$$マオ$$
「Even if it's a hollow shell, those are the guys who repaired the $$アーバレスト$$, too.」

294:t_1:41.en:
$$宗介$$
「Even without $$アル$$ and the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$, I will fight.」

294:t_1:42.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Is that so you can rescue $$かなめ$$?」

294:t_1:44.en:
$$クルツ$$
「After all that, we left Southeast Asia behind and headed for the $$スコート・ラボ$$ in North America.」

294:t_1:45.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「And that's where you met those people, right?」

294:t_1:46.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「...So $$桂$$ was helping with Dr. $$トライア$$'s research on super-dimensional physics?」

294:t_1:47.en:
$$桂$$
「Helping? Well... mostly I was used as a guinea pig.」

294:t_1:48.en:
$$モーム$$
「But thanks to that, the doctor's research seems to have made quite a lot of progress.」

294:t_1:49.en:
$$桂$$
「After all, to hide from the $$サイデリアル$$, the doctor has been holed up in a secret facility separate from the lab the whole time.」

294:t_1:50.en:
$$ルカ$$
「What kind of research is that?」

294:t_1:51.en:
$$桂$$
「Unfortunately, I wasn't told either, you see.」

294:t_1:52.en:
$$ルカ$$
「But what surprised me most was Dr. $$トライア$$'s $$リモネシア$$ Report.」

294:t_1:53.en:
$$ルカ$$
「To think that the ancient ruins found in $$リモネシア$$ near the end of the $$時獄戦役$$ were left behind by our world's $$プロトカルチャー$$...」

294:t_1:54.en:
$$クラン$$
「So the $$プロトカルチャー$$ also had a means of traveling between parallel worlds.」

294:t_1:55.en:
$$ルカ$$
「And from the materials left in those ruins, the mechanism of the universe's collapse that occurs once every 12,000 years also became clear.」
